meta.title: Science Learning Lab
meta.description: Interactive science simulations for high school: biology, chemistry, physics and medicine.

nav.prototype: Prototype – not for use with students

home.title: See science happen
home.lead: Simulations where students change variables, measure, plot a graph and draw a conclusion – like in the lab, on any device.
home.curveCaption: Simplified educational model: the rate rises with temperature up to an optimum, then falls sharply as the enzyme loses its structure.
home.howSims: Each simulation is an independent module with its own scientific model and documentation.
home.howActivities: Each simulation can carry several activities – for different grades, levels and goals.
home.howTeachers: Teachers will build activities without coding, and later with AI.
